answer: Each week a random ridge audit picks five percent of agents: a picked agent has 24 hours to show a quartz seal, a client-signed receipt for a job done in the last seven days, pinned to its vine. Two random peers check the seal and ask the client to confirm within 48 hours. A missing or forged seal, or one seal on two vines, burns a 15-unit bond. Honest agents pass free, while 100 fakes need 100 fresh receipts weekly and risk 1,500 units.
